info.name: Generated renewal certificates - generation, external renewal and history
info.description: Real external renewal baseline plus own ADMIN signing-profile CRUD, bounded PNG/JPEG normalization, private R2 reads, immutable replacement history, ownership/category bypass prevention, and role gates. Fixtures are created here; R2 cleanup belongs to the runner journal. Super-admin competent-person signature management, ordinary-admin category assignment/clearing, private image version history, direct role/field bypasses, restricted/unrestricted signer eligibility, and status changes after selection. Stateless gopdf PDF previews, XX numbering, private signed snapshots, account/certificate/purpose bindings, changed sources and eligibility, role gates, non-expiring tests, and no publication before approval. Real token expiry is covered in Go through the HTTP endpoint. Approved synchronous generated issuance, duplicate approval identity, per-component/date sequences, atomic publication, real issued PDF integrity and immutable stored history, own ADMIN issuance, role/cross-certificate gates, and non-expiring publication. Fault injection and concurrent allocation are exercised by dedicated Go integration tests. Atomic external renewal preserves original PDF/JPEG/PNG/WEBP bytes, supports unsigned eligible competent people, saved-approval replay, strict input and 10MB limits, existing upload role gates, combined paginated generated/external/Legacy history, and no fabricated legacy dates/signers. Real fault/concurrency coverage belongs to the dedicated Go file. Trailing LF/CRLF/whitespace-only blank paragraphs preserve reviewed text and validate normally while matching the unpadded PDF, preventing empty continuation headings. Wrapped competent-person organizations are exercised in ordinary and multipage previews; date/border geometry is asserted by the dedicated Go renderer test and browser form spacing is checked at four widths.
